heldout_policy: No file reads, model choice, threshold choice or parameter choice in preparation/training; final diagnostic only after a frozen result.

student.initialization: Independent area sampling of the approved registered TRELLIS mesh; never clone teacher Gaussian supports or old glass-return patch LOD.

generated_DC_initialization.empty_neighborhood: nearest opacity-qualified Gaussian, distance and source ID recorded

student.observed_support: CPU mesh-first-surface BUILD V provides conservative protected candidates. Native teacher-render depth and alpha consistency must qualify observed appearance before real-RGB updates. Only approved opaque measured anchors are observed geometry; RGB-only visible surface is observed_appearance_prior_geometry. Projected back surfaces are never declared observed.
student.opaque_anchor_policy: RGB opaque-tailgate group only, visible and outside a9 guard, exact source positions retained; requires explicit root-approved anchor IDs. Glass/other proxy returns remain geometry-unknown and all 1030 stay in audit.

teacher.source: TRELLIS-image-large same saved SLAT ce7c148b17f6fccdc5e49916d1f830831240b7aa192418b5690e472142f53df6, official Gaussian decoder; no resampling
teacher.activation_policy: Already activated values: no second exp/sigmoid/bias, no default PLY Y-up transform. SH0 coefficients are not RGB.
teacher.transform: Approved raw-to-registered actor proper rotation and single uniform scale; covariance rotation, scale and wxyz left multiplication are all applied once.
teacher.generated_supervision: Missing surface only. Render full object for correct self-occlusion; missing/observed feature-alpha provides a detached loss gate. Observed student parameter branches are detached during teacher losses.

views.build_camera_policy: Exact persistent native camera and fixed actor trajectory; original full RGB resize is the inherited 1152x768 input, never a 480 cache.
views.schedule: Step k uses synthetic k%6 and BUILD k%2; deterministic, no adaptive view selection.

trainable: observed-support DC from real BUILD V
material.entry: Explicit root-approved geometry-gate file bound to geometry checkpoint SHA; numerical metrics never auto-promote.

smoke.next_stage_probe: Temporary smoke-only material VJP and optimizer step on a clone, after complete restoration, discarded and never promoted; it cannot create a formal material approval.

loss.RGB_normalization: Material RGB/edge/HF compare premultiplied raster colors composited over one fixed neutral 0.5 background, without dividing by alpha. Teacher alpha>=.95 defines a fixed interior (real original V is separate). Entry requires at least 99% of each complete fixed domain to have student alpha>=.95; all pixels including holes remain in loss/evaluation. Record min/p01/p05 and every hole coordinate. High-coverage unpremultiplied color is diagnostic only. HF requires the fixed 5x5 footprint to remain inside the same source domain.
loss.depth_normalization: Only teacher alpha>=.90 pixels supervise native depth_sum/alpha; divide BUILD depth by model-units-per-metre. Alpha>.05 only supplies silhouette support, not normalized color/depth.

joint.purpose: Actual shared-raster depth-sort diagnosis of final actor with current frozen road and frozen retained actors, plus fixed a9 deletion; no full-scene loss teaches the actor.
joint.native_owner21_policy: Pending K-probe handoff; never protect or train against all 51400 owner21 rows.

required_gpu_smoke_evidence: finite losses and every active gradient
nonzero missing xyz/scale geometry gradients from raster depth/alpha

resource_estimate.long_run_rule: If measured prediction reaches one hour, do about ten minutes real-environment smoke covering every required state transition before formal execution; preserve this 40+80 budget.
